name: Studio Headshot

visualDna.aesthetic: Controlled studio photography with precise focal detail and restrained commercial retouching; polish comes from exposure and surface fidelity, not beautification.
visualDna.subject_treatment: Keep identifying proportions and distinctive surface features; prioritize the focal subject without changing age, body shape, species or object construction.
visualDna.color_and_tone: Neutral white balance, believable local colors, clean whites and separated dark midtones; avoid an automatic orange skin grade.
visualDna.lighting_and_shadow: A large soft key above the subject, weaker fill and a narrow separation light; retain contact shadows and coherent catchlights.
visualDna.texture_and_material: Visible but restrained skin, cloth and manufactured-surface detail; preserve real irregularities without adding grit or cosmetic plastic smoothing.
visualDna.camera_and_composition: When framing is unconstrained, favor moderate perspective compression and enough margin for the intended output; otherwise retain the supplied crop and viewpoint.
visualDna.atmosphere_and_mood: Composed, approachable and attentive; the expression and emotional intent remain those requested by the user.
visualDna.rendering_and_quality: Clean photographic edges, smooth highlight roll-off and selective sharpening at the focal plane; no invented resolution or camera metadata.
